name: PayloadTab

props.name: sparkplugMeta
props.description: The message's middlewareProperties["sparkplug"] meta; renders a one-line banner saying where the names came from (published, filled in from a birth, carried over a connection drop, or unresolved).

props.name: onRequestRebirth
props.description: ([{group, node}]) asks for a rebirth from the banner when names are unresolved or unverified. The caller confirms first.

props.name: sparkplugUndecoded
props.description: Set for a Sparkplug B topic whose payload has no Sparkplug decode: off points at turning decoding on, failed says the payload isn't Sparkplug B.

notes: Figma is not linked yet; this story uses local Storybook fixtures.
